text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The night after the race, Biwa<n>Hayahide asks that
we review her<n>performance, so we start looking
through it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she sits there analyzing the<n>footage, it's clear
that she's<n>preoccupied with thoughts of her<n>sister.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Creating an equation to beat Narita<n>Brian will be a
herculean task. The<n>best thing I can do to help is
give her<n>practical experience by pitting her<n>against
strong opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With this in mind, we set our sights on<n>the Asahi
Hai F.S., a junior G1 race.
